moisture_pct.quote: - 474.6 g/kg = **47.46 %** – fresh ovine, Cyprus retail, fresh

ammonia.reason: No extensive amino acid deamination in fresh low-proteolysis cooked curd at pH 5.9.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole not detected; clean pasteurized make limits phenol formation.

bitter.reason: Short age prevents hydrophobic peptide accumulation from chymosin proteolysis.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium inoculation and no methyl-ketone pathway from mold lipases.

browning.reason: Grill Maillard between residual lactose and lysine on low-moisture surface forms crust.

buttery.reason: Very low diacetyl/acetoin from no starter citrate metabolism and whey-cooking volatilization.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic 28.13 mg/kg indicates minimal lipolysis without mold lipases.

creaminess.reason: 26% fat but dense denatured whey-casein network inhibits oral fat coalescence.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic cooked rennet gel deforms rather than fracturing like weak acid curd.

firmness.reason: High-heat whey cooking contracts para-casein with calcium-phosphate crosslinks at pH 5.9 causing squeak.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol not quantified; minimal phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: No quantified ethyl esters; only trace methyl butanoate peak area without brine aging.

goaty.reason: Caproic 60 mg/kg plus caprylic 66 mg/kg short-chain FFAs from ovine-caprine milk.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal only as peak area; no aged leucine Strecker aldehyde accumulation.

melt.reason: Heat-set whey protein-casein complex at pH 5.9 prevents para-casein flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 1-octen-3-one not detected; no surface-mold lipoxygenase activity.

oil_off.reason: Fat globules trapped by denatured whey-protein coat limit free oil despite 26% fat.

smoky.reason: Typical plain Halloumi unsmoked; no guaiacol phenols from smoking.

sour_vinegar.reason: Acetic 189.19 mg/kg and propanoic 107.81 mg/kg at pH 5.9 show limited acidification.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata acidification to pH 5.2-5.4 and no hot-water kneading to align casein.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Whey-cooking near 90C denatures beta-lactoglobulin releasing H2S and cooked-milk sulfides.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose at high pH 5.9 retains milky sweetness without lactic sourness.

umami.reason: Low free glutamate from minimal rennet proteolysis in unaged cooked curd.
